messages:
alex (Support): FYI customer acme-tech upgraded to our SDK v2.1.0 and started getting 400s for function/tool calls. Says required keys are missing from fn args. Error id `err_0a9f1c`.

maria (Support): repro steps from customer:
1) call /v1/chat with function call
2) body: {
  "model": "gpt-x",
  "messages": [...],
  "function_call": {"name":"process_orders","arguments":"[{\"order_id\":\"123\"}]"}
}
-> runtime returns 400: "invalid function arguments: order_ids must be array"

alex (Support): note the arguments are a stringified JSON array — looks like SDK is serializing arrays into strings on this path.

raj (Eng): thanks, adding context. We shipped a change in v2.1.0 that coerces non-object payload parts into strings to avoid multipart problems. Seems it accidentally stringified nested arrays in function_call.arguments. Repro locally with the SDK that customer used.

raj (Eng): quick repro command:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"model":"gpt-x","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"run"}],"function_call":{"name":"process_orders","arguments":[{"order_id":"123"}]}}'
```
When using SDK wrapper v2.1.0 it ends up sending arguments as a quoted string instead of array.

sara (SRE): customer also reported intermittent 401s during the incident window. Could be token rotation + client retries causing extra billable attempts. Billing looped in.

jordan (Billing): saw a burst of small failed calls from that customer during 2026-02-28 14:10–14:18 UTC. They got charged for the attempts per our policy. Customer upset and requesting credit. Requested logs and exact fail counts.

alex (Support): immediate ask: can we provide a short-term mitigation and a patch plan? Customer is on Dedicated but using our SDK. They can pin to v2.0.3 which doesn't have the coercion change.

raj (Eng): mitigation: downgrade to SDK v2.0.3 or manually ensure function_call.arguments serialized as JSON (stringify on client) — but careful, that would produce the same problem. Better: pin to 2.0.3.
Patch plan: rolling hotfix to SDK to avoid stringifying arrays — reverting that coercion. Also add server-side lenient parse for function arguments that are quoted JSON arrays to maintain compatibility while we roll out SDK patch.

maria (Support): asked customer to pin SDK and provided command and timeline. Customer requested ETA on server-side tolerant parse as they can't upgrade pin immediately.

raj (Eng): ETA for server-side tolerance: quick middleware change — 1 business day to deploy canary, 2–3 days for full rollout with observability. Hotfix to SDK: PR open https://git.redwood.ai/sdk/pull/482 — awaiting review, likely 48 hours.

sara (SRE): warning: server-side tolerant parse must be gated behind feature flag and strict validation for other customers. We should also log a metric for "fn_args_stringified" to catch regressions.

alex (Support): customer also saw increased latency (avg p50 went 120ms -> 300ms) during window — maybe due to retries. Any memory of retry loops on client when 401 occurs?

raj (Eng): yes if Authorization fails mid-stream the SDK retries at transport layer, we observed up to 3 retries in that SDK version even for 4xx. We'll patch retry logic to not retry on 401/403.

jordan (Billing): summary of impact: 87 failed attempts charged, 12 successful after retry, total billable = 99 calls. Customer wants credit for the failed 87. Support to escalate.

maria (Support): opened ticket TW-5421, added logs, request for credit, and asked for an incident RCA. Noted customer SLA: Dedicated with 99.9% uptime, SLA credit may apply for sustained failures.

raj (Eng): next steps for Eng:
- prioritize SDK PR revert & test (owner: @raj)
- implement server-side tolerant parse feature flag + metric (owner: @raj, @sara)
- change retry policy in SDK to avoid retrying on auth failures (owner: SDK team)

sara (SRE): deployment plan: canary to 5% tomorrow after QA, monitor fn_args_stringified metric and latency; full 100% in 48h if stable.

alex (Support): interim customer message sent: pin SDK v2.0.3, we'll rollback coercion and add tolerant parse; asking for patience and offering to review billing once we have final counts. Customer responded :thumbsup: and asked for timeline.

jordan (Billing): please cc me on the final log dump and we will prepare credit assessment once fix is confirmed.

raj (Eng): logging note: example of malformed payload we should detect server-side and auto-normalize:
```
"function_call": {"name":"process_orders","arguments":"[{\"order_id\":\"123\"},{\"order_id\":\"124\"}]"}
```
We will auto-parse quoted JSON arrays into arrays and add an audit field `__args_normalized":true` for visibility.

sara (SRE): add a guard: only normalize if arguments parses to valid JSON and matches declared function schema. Avoid normalizing arbitrary strings.

maria (Support): closing loop: customer agreed to pin and also asked for a temporary webhook to receive corrected webhook events instead of polling. Support to coordinate with Integrations team.

alex (Support): tagging follow-ups: @raj please update TW-5421 with PR links & timeline; @jordan share billing calc; @sara push canary schedule. Thanks everyone :heart:

build-bot: deploy started for canary feature flag fd-args-tolerant at 2026-03-01T02:00:00Z

raj (Eng): will follow up here as soon as PR merges and canary is healthy.
